meta.title: Duplicate Detection: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role on the tenant
Use Duplicate Detection to match new vendors against existing PAN, GST, bank, email, and mobile records
Repeat the action as a Buyer in the same tenant
Compare the non-Buyer refusal or absence with the Buyer's availability
Record tenant RBAC configuration if the feature is intentionally granted to additional roles
